# tslider

A lightweight and accessible image slider built with TypeScript.

## Project

tslider is a TypeScript-based image slider focused on accessibility,
responsive behavior, keyboard navigation, autoplay controls, touch
interaction, and smooth slide transitions.

## Features

- Keyboard navigation
- Previous and next controls
- Dot navigation
- Autoplay
- Pause on hover
- Pause when the page is not visible
- Reduced motion support
- Touch and drag interaction
- Responsive layout
- Accessible controls
